script_text:
Stop! Aquarius, the stars are screaming at you right now—an Air sign feeling the electric storm.
Mars is squaring Uranus, your ruler, blasting sudden impulses into your 1st House and sparking a clash with your partner’s Mars in your 7th House. Jupiter’s trine to your 10th House lifts your public image and offers a promotion.
If you’re single, the Mercury‑Neptune sextile in your 5th House draws charismatic admirers, but keep expectations grounded and brightening your romance. If you’re coupled, the Mars‑Uranus square in your 7th warns of impulsive fights; pause before you speak.
Your 2nd House receives a steady sextile from Saturn in your 8th, urging disciplined budgeting and an unexpected side‑income by month‑end, strengthening your financial foundation.
Avoid rash decisions under the Uranus‑Mars square; the blessing is a hidden talent for negotiation that surfaces when you stay calm.
Follow for tomorrow's reading and the next cosmic clue.
